args.message: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.head: fix/banker-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP.

This change switches `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior and the test expectations (e.g., 2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).

CI: passed (ci-0001)
